harness.auroc: Mann-Whitney, ties count 1/2, higher score ranks as the injected class
harness.energy_detector: max of squared samples; location unknown; harness baseline
harness.oracle_detector: squared sample at the known injection index; harness baseline
harness.positive_call: score > threshold. QGITA thresholds are on max_g_eff and lighthouse intensity, the analyzer's existing scores. Energy and oracle use their own scores.
harness.qgita_thresholds: fit only on calibration nulls so about 5 percent of those null scores lie strictly above the threshold. Evaluation seeds are disjoint. Constructor defaults of the analyzer are unchanged. native_ftcp and native_lhe in each cell are the untuned gates, kept for comparison.
harness.shuffle: stdlib Random(seed + 50000).shuffle of the signal trial
harness.signal: one-sample impulse added to unit-variance Gaussian noise

injection.rule: Eligible knots have phi_deviation <= FTCPDetector.epsilon and both neighbor knots inside the series. tight_lattice is the eligible knot with the smallest product of the adjacent knot gaps. mid_lattice is the eligible knot closest to N/3. off_lattice is the integer nearest the midpoint from mid_lattice toward the next knot that is not itself a knot time.
